name: ose-primer
description: Repository template for OSE-style polyglot Nx monorepos

scripts.crud-be:dev:restart: cd infra/dev/crud-be-java-springboot && docker compose down && docker compose up
scripts.generate:bindings: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness bindings generate
scripts.sync:agents: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness bindings generate --harness opencode
scripts.sync:skills: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness bindings generate --harness opencode
scripts.sync:dry-run: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness bindings generate --harness opencode --dry-run
scripts.validate:sync: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness sync validate
scripts.validate:claude: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness claude validate
scripts.validate:config: npm run validate:claude && npm run generate:bindings && npm run validate:opencode
scripts.harness:bindings-validation: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness bindings validate

*.md: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md mermaid validate
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md heading-hierarchy validate
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md naming validate
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md frontmatter validate
*.{json,toml,ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs,rs,go: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- convention emoji validate
*.feature: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- specs gherkin-cardinality validate
docker-compose*.{yml,yaml}: bash -c 'for f; do docker compose -f "$f" config > /dev/null; done' --
